offline_checks.command: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
offline_checks.description: GitHub requests and model responses are simulated in these tests.

live_smoke_test.description: One live functional check verifies connectivity and data flow, not general model quality.

limitations: Jobs are in-process and in-memory; a backend restart clears them.
Source-ID validation does not prove semantic correctness of the model's claims.
Duplicate detection, label recommendations, durable jobs and public deployment are outside M1.
